## Load Data

```{r}
capture <- read_csv("rodent_abundance/scr_clean.csv")

# remove extraneous species
sp_richness_f25 <- capture %>% filter(is.na(extraneous), season == "Fall", yr == 2025)

# create list of unique species
sp_list_f25 <- sp_richness_f25 %>% distinct(species)

# count unique species
sp_count_f25 <- count(sp_list_f25)

# Site Specific
# list of species per site
site_sp_list_f25 <- sp_richness_f25 %>% 
  group_by(site) %>% 
  distinct(species)

# count species per site
site_sp_count_f25 <- site_sp_list_f25 %>% 
  group_by(site) %>% 
  summarise(n_species = n())

ggplot(site_sp_count_f25, aes(x = site, y = n_species, fill = site))+
  geom_col()+
  ylab("Species Richness")+
  theme_bw() + 
  scale_fill_viridis_d(end = 0.95) 

ggsave("outputs/site_sp_richness_f25.png", width=4, height=4)
```

```{r}
sp_abund_f25 <- sp_richness_f25 %>% filter(is.na(recap)) #remove recaps

## plot
#abund_by_site_period <- abund_by_site_period %>% mutate(total = sum(abund_by_site_period$n_species))

abund <- ggplot(sp_abund_f25, aes(x=site))+
  geom_bar(aes(fill = species), position = "stack")+
  geom_text(stat = "count", aes(label = ..count..), vjust = -1)+
  ylim(NA, 37)+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(legend.position = "none")+
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "plasma", direction = -1, end = 0.8, begin = 0.15)+
  labs(y = "Abundance", x = "Site", fill = "Species")

ggsave("outputs/abund_f25.png", width=8, height=4)
```

```{r}
rel_abund_f25 <- sp_abund_f25 %>% group_by(site, species) %>% 
  count() %>% 
  ungroup(species) %>% 
  mutate(site_abund = sum(n)) %>% 
  mutate(rel_abund = n/site_abund)

rel_abund <- ggplot(rel_abund_f25, aes(x = site, y = rel_abund)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = species), position = "stack")+
  theme_bw()+
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "plasma", direction = -1, end = 0.8, begin = 0.15)+
  labs(y = "Relative Abundance", x = "Site", fill = "Species")

ggsave("outputs/rel_abund_f25.png", width=8, height=4)

```

```{r}
abund + rel_abund +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

ggsave("outputs/abund+rel_abund.png", width=8, height=4)
```

```{r}
shannon_site <- rel_abund_f25 %>% mutate(proportion = rel_abund*log(rel_abund)) %>% 
  summarise(shannon_index = sum(proportion)) %>% 
  mutate(shannon_index = shannon_index*-1)
```
